note: Window agent p1680-p1689: two keyframe holes closed (Qing 1680-81, Mughal 1687-90). A Denmark-Norway/Sweden ruling for 1683 was drafted and withdrawn: the conflict no longer arises in the current dossiers.

minus.text: Yunnan, still held by Wu Shifan until Kunming falls in October 1681, and Taiwan with Penghu, held by Tungning until 1683

correction.text: the 1677 Qing shape plus the whole Three Feudatories zone except Yunnan and Taiwan (Chongqing, south Shaanxi and the rest of the rebel zone included): by 1680 Wu's successor holds only Yunnan

keyframe_overrides.why: The old 1680 shape listed admin-1 provinces only and left out Chongqing (307 cells), the Hubei and south Shaanxi strips and about 30 more cells, which the ledger had just given the Qing (wu-sangui-s-zhou ledger/12), so the snap emptied them until the 1682 keyframe. The page: 'the provinces of Hunan, Guizhou, Guangxi, and Sichuan were recovered by the Qing' and 'Sichuan and southern Shaanxi were retaken by the Han Chinese Green Standard Army under Wang Jinbao and Zhao Liangdong in 1680'; Kunming falls only in October 1681. Chongqing was part of Sichuan province. Hubei strip: the page names no date; it is bridged to 1680 because wu-sangui-s-zhou_1680 holds Yunnan alone (confidence 2). Taiwan, Penghu and Keelung are left out because kingdom-of-tungning_1680 holds them until 1683 (Cliopatria's Southern Ming 1677 row includes Taiwan).

correction.text: the 1687 Mughal shape (fx-10 exclusions kept) plus the annexed Adil Shahi land of Bijapur (Sept 1686) and the Qutb Shahi land of Golconda (Sept 1687), drawn as the two dossiers' own last shapes

keyframe_overrides.why: Cliopatria's 1687 Mughal shape carries only 66 Karnataka and 232 of 439 Telangana cells, so the keyframe snap stripped about 970 cells of Bijapur and Golconda that the ledger had given the Mughals (mughal-empire ledger/98, ledger/101) and left them as nobody's land until the 1691 keyframe. Siege of Golconda: 'On 21 September 1687, a Golconda noble named Sarandaz Khan betrayed the Sultanate' and the sultanate 'was annexed into the Mughal Empire'; the infobox says 'Mughal Empire annexes Golconda Sultanate, Hyderabad Subah is formed' and that the Mughals 'successfully besieged Bijapur in 1685-1686'. The correction adds the two states' own last shapes (bijapur-sultanate_1683, golconda-sultanate_1687) to the old correction, keeping the fx-10 exclusions.
